inputs.name: hand over from Containerization to Orchestration

output.level_0: Container builds fail nightly, so the orchestration scheduler crashes before it can trigger any forecast job.
output.level_1: No orchestration layer exists, so the team manually SSHs into servers to run the containerized forecast script.
output.level_2: A human manually starts the containerized forecast job every night using a simple command line script.
output.level_3: The orchestrator automatically spins up forecast containers nightly and retries failed jobs without human intervention.
output.level_4: The governed orchestrator logs every container launch, enforces resource limits, and alerts on scheduling delays.
